SIM_VERSION
nodes.rationale: Bumped whenever sim behaviour changes so replay can detect divergence.

nodes.label: UNAVOIDABLE decision exclusion
nodes.rationale: SPEC 9.6 fairness: a pop-up threat inside one effector cycle says nothing about the decision.

nodes.label: No raw hex colour lint rule
HUD uses only operator-known facts
nodes.rationale: The HUD must not leak ground truth.

nodes.label: Generate rate limit (in-memory)
nodes.rationale: Single API process; a shared store needed when scaled out.

nodes.label: Decision 1 Scenario shape follows SPEC 4.4
nodes.rationale: The example is what scripted scenarios will look like; scripted scenarios have no ScenarioRequest.

nodes.label: Decision 2 Scenario id plain string and scenarios.code
nodes.rationale: Scripted scenarios have human codes, DB rows use UUIDs.

nodes.label: Decision 3 trackId and contactId top-level in SimEvent
nodes.rationale: Matches session_events columns and the batch example; avoids two sources of truth.

nodes.label: Decision 4 session_events seq unique
nodes.rationale: Replay ordering and idempotent ingestion need it.

nodes.label: Decision 5 Scenario coordinates
nodes.rationale: The spec mixed ENU and Three.js conventions; flip only in coords.ts.

nodes.label: Decision 6 All enums in enums.ts
nodes.rationale: Adding an enum value later is non-breaking; ACOUSTIC omitted until implemented.

nodes.label: Decision 7 Sensor and effector configs keyed on kind
nodes.rationale: Penalty and PerContactMetrics provisional until Phase 1 scoring.

nodes.label: Decision 8 Auth identity mapping
nodes.rationale: One code path for RBAC; token claims cannot escalate privilege.

nodes.label: Decision 9 No passwords in our DB
nodes.rationale: users has no password column and Supabase owns credentials.

nodes.label: Decision 10 Production auth guard
nodes.rationale: ENV=prod requires supabase auth; JWKS cannot verify legacy HS256 tokens.

nodes.label: Decision 11 sim-core RNG built in Phase 0
nodes.rationale: Foundational and has no dependencies.

nodes.label: Tooling decision 1 TypeScript pinned to 6.0
nodes.rationale: typescript-eslint supports <6.1.

nodes.label: Tooling decision 2 zod 4 built-in toJSONSchema
nodes.rationale: No extra zod-to-json-schema dependency.

nodes.label: Tooling decision 3 One bundled JSON Schema to one Python module
nodes.rationale: Simple, deterministic codegen.

nodes.label: Tooling decision 4 pnpm dev parallel
nodes.rationale: No concurrently dependency.

nodes.label: Tooling decision 5 Sync SQLAlchemy 2 and psycopg 3
nodes.rationale: Simpler than async; unit-sized load is tiny.

nodes.label: Tooling decision 6 Stdlib JSON-lines logging
nodes.rationale: No extra dependency (structlog).

nodes.label: Tooling decision 7 LF line endings and no codegen timestamp
nodes.rationale: Windows dev machines must not create diffs in CI's no-diff check.

nodes.label: Tooling decision 8 Tests use real Postgres
nodes.rationale: Tables use jsonb and text[].

nodes.label: Tooling decision 9 Web auth guard is client-side
nodes.rationale: Token in browser storage as Supabase JS does; middleware guard is tech debt.

nodes.label: Tooling decision 10 UPPER_SNAKE Pydantic enums and discriminators
nodes.rationale: Readable Python, fast and precise validation errors via tagged unions.

nodes.label: Tooling decision 11 uvicorn factory mode
nodes.rationale: Importing the app module must not require env vars.

nodes.label: Tooling decision 12 Error code map duplicated in Python with cross-check
nodes.rationale: The map is a constant, not a type; JSON Schema cannot carry it.

nodes.label: Tooling decision 13 Web uses system font stacks
nodes.rationale: Builds and runs fully offline.

nodes.label: Tooling decision 14 shadcn components added by hand
nodes.rationale: The CLI is interactive and network-bound; output is equivalent.

nodes.label: Decision 15 unrs-resolver build script denied
nodes.rationale: pnpm blocks unapproved install scripts; package ships prebuilt binaries.

nodes.label: Decision 16 PRs are rebase-merged
nodes.rationale: Single developer; individual commits on main keep readable history; CI gates every PR.

nodes.label: Decision 17 Phase 1 procedural heightmap terrain
nodes.rationale: Exercises the same sampleHeight path that Phase 2 real-DEM presets use.

nodes.label: Decision 18 Score scale
nodes.rationale: Total scaled to 100 over scored components; never-detectable threats excluded (SPEC 9.6).

nodes.label: Decision 19 Trainee detected definition
nodes.rationale: A trainee who classifies without pressing D clearly noticed the track.

nodes.label: Decision 20 Decision-tree format
nodes.rationale: if/bands/leaf nodes, adjust penalties, excluded for fairness; pytest requires a test case per leaf.

nodes.label: Decision 21 Enum additions UNRESOLVED and NO_AMMO
nodes.rationale: Needed for Phase 1 outcomes and responses.

nodes.label: Decision 22 EW commands rejected in Phase 1
nodes.rationale: No EW effectors yet; reject rather than fake an outcome.

nodes.label: Decision 23 Radar tracks associate by ground truth
nodes.rationale: Data association is out of scope for the MVP; trainee still only sees track ids.

nodes.label: Decision 24 Plausibility per batch and on complete
nodes.rationale: Detects lost batches, duplicates and post-end events; a failing batch is rejected whole.

nodes.label: Decision 25 response_model_exclude_unset
nodes.rationale: zod optional rejects null.

nodes.label: Decision 26 Real sim logs as API fixtures
nodes.rationale: API tests exercise exactly what the client sends; stale fixtures fail a sim-core test.

nodes.label: Decision 27 MAX_EVENTS_PER_SESSION mirrored in Python
nodes.rationale: Same cross-check pattern as decision 12.

nodes.label: Decision 28 Elo update deferred to Phase 5
nodes.rationale: Elo is listed in SPEC 12 under adaptive difficulty.

nodes.label: Decision 29 DEM source Copernicus GLO-30
nodes.rationale: Free, global, 30 m, clear attribution; boxes vetted against OSM for military features.

nodes.label: Decision 30 heightmap.u16 load format
nodes.rationale: Browser canvas decode is 8-bit; origin-relative heights keep the defended position near y=0.

nodes.label: Decision 31 buildings.geojson in local metres
nodes.rationale: No projection library needed; coordinates match the DEM grid.

nodes.label: Decision 32 scripts/terrain is its own uv project
nodes.rationale: GDAL/osmnx are heavy and must not enter the API image.

nodes.label: Decision 33 Preset meta authoritative for origin and utcOffsetMin
nodes.rationale: One source of truth; explicit offset keeps sun computation deterministic.

nodes.label: Decision 34 World object
nodes.rationale: Heightmap, buildings and LOS passed to createSim; PROCEDURAL_HILLS kept as built-in.

nodes.label: Decision 35 Radar LOS factor only in Part A
nodes.rationale: Masked contact still consumes its fixed random draws to preserve determinism.

nodes.label: Decision 36 Camera pointing is sim state
nodes.rationale: EO_IDENTIFIABLE depends on pointing and mode, so both come from logged commands for exact replay.

nodes.label: Decision 37 Slew logging throttle
nodes.rationale: Final CAMERA_SLEWED per gesture; up to 0.5 s lag accepted.

nodes.label: Decision 38 EO/IR model constants
nodes.rationale: Representative IR cap 1.5x visibility, thermal contrast scaling, 1 s hysteresis.

nodes.label: Decision 39 identifiableWhenClassified keys off EO sensor
nodes.rationale: A trainee who never pointed the camera classified before the contact was identifiable.

nodes.label: Decision 40 Single canvas
nodes.rationale: One WebGL context, one copy of terrain/buildings on the GPU.

nodes.label: Decision 41 Terrain LOD
nodes.rationale: SPEC 16 draw-call and tick budgets.

nodes.label: Decision 42 S11 and S12 are test scenarios
nodes.rationale: Separate from the S01-S10 training library.

nodes.label: Decision 43 Scripted guard 45 s minimum warning
nodes.rationale: With LOS masking S03 leaves 58.5 s; guard tests 'defensible in time' directly.

nodes.label: Decision 44 Tactical map night lighting is a display aid
nodes.rationale: Tactical view stands in for a C2 map display; only the sensor view is degraded by night.

nodes.label: Decision 45 FPS measured in headless Chrome
nodes.rationale: Visible windows get throttled or receive stray input; headless keeps the GPU path.

nodes.label: Decision 46 Display-only seeder updates
nodes.rationale: Replay and scores depend on gameplay content, but wording fixes should not need a new code.

nodes.label: Decision 47 RESPONSE_OUTCOME collateral is a list
nodes.rationale: One jam sector can affect several contacts.

nodes.label: Decision 48 SIM_VERSION
nodes.rationale: Part B changes the sim, so old sessions will not replay exactly; replay must check the version.

nodes.label: Decision 49 Class profiles reach Python as a generated file
nodes.rationale: One source of truth for threat data without Python reading packages/ at runtime.

nodes.label: Decision 50 Rain is a two-way SNR loss
nodes.rationale: Path attenuation grows with range, unlike a fixed Pd factor; accepted divergence from SPEC 6.1.

nodes.label: Decision 51 2D alpha-beta track filter
nodes.rationale: Better tracks, but radar bearing noise cannot keep a 1.5 deg frame on target; track height leaks truth (tech debt).

nodes.label: Decision 52 EO video auto-track
nodes.rationale: Real C-UAS EO systems are radar-cued then hold the target with a video tracker.

nodes.label: Decision 53 RF output bearing strobes and badges
nodes.rationale: Trainee acts on tracks, not strobes; RF-only contacts are not detectable so scoring stays fair.

nodes.label: Decision 54 EW sector not ROE-gated
nodes.rationale: Matches SPEC 8 effectiveness table and jam-hits-friendlies constraint; sector makes bearing checks a real decision.

nodes.label: Decision 55 FRIENDLY_JAMMED and CIVILIAN_JAMMED penalties
nodes.rationale: Jamming a friendly is serious but recoverable; civilian collateral is a sector-awareness lesson.

nodes.label: Decision 56 UNAVOIDABLE excludes only decision component
nodes.rationale: SPEC 9.6 fairness; a leak penalty would double-count lost decision points.

nodes.label: Decision 57 Birds in default_v2
nodes.rationale: A wasted EW order is a discrimination error worth debriefing, a round fired at a bird is harmful.

nodes.label: Decision 58 DESIGN.md wins over older UI wording
nodes.rationale: DESIGN.md is binding for UI and later; two sources of truth on type size would drift.

nodes.label: Decision 59 Seeded S02 Two Axes stays
nodes.rationale: S01-S03 are frozen; stored sessions and scores reference them.

nodes.label: Decision 60 IBM Plex via next/font/local
nodes.rationale: next/font/google downloads at build time, breaking the offline Docker build; Plex is OFL.

nodes.label: Decision 61 In-house Tooltip primitive
nodes.rationale: Avoids a new dependency for a ~50-line component.

nodes.label: Decision 62 No raw hex outside two files
nodes.rationale: Colour is information, so it must come from one place (DESIGN 3/12).

nodes.label: Decision 63 Dev-only routes are page.dev.tsx
nodes.rationale: DESIGN 12 requires the gallery excluded from production, not merely hidden.

nodes.label: Decision 64 Recommendation fields added after scoring engine
nodes.rationale: Keeps engine output byte-identical so golden re-score tests stay meaningful.

nodes.label: Decision 65 Feedback strings humanised on the client
nodes.rationale: Tree JSON is immutable once used; a new tree version only for copy is not worth it.

nodes.label: Decision 66 Disabled reasons use only operator-known facts
nodes.rationale: The HUD must not leak ground truth; pre-disabling changes no score.

nodes.label: Decision 67 Visual baselines deterministic and local-only
nodes.rationale: Stepping to a fixed tick makes the HUD reproducible; Windows-rendered so CI does not diff them yet.

nodes.label: Decision 68 Ground-truth defender
nodes.rationale: One defender for media and validation without changing guard tests.

nodes.label: Decision 69 NO_KINETIC judged on estimated track position
nodes.rationale: Intercepts resolve instantly, so track position equals intercept point; must move if time-of-flight is modelled.

nodes.label: Decision 70 SIM_VERSION 3
nodes.rationale: Generator's SMUGGLING_DROP and ROE semantics need DROP/RTH waypoints, WEAPONS_TIGHT, NO_KINETIC gate and observed release.

nodes.label: Decision 71 Defender respects new gates
nodes.rationale: Validator's defender-wins check must reflect what a correct operator could do.

nodes.label: Decision 72 default_v3 payload drop is a leak
nodes.rationale: A delivered payload is the smuggler's mission accomplished whatever happens afterwards.

nodes.label: Decision 73 Server-side terrain TERRAIN_DIR and stdlib reader
nodes.rationale: One source of truth for terrain, no numpy in the API; fixtures stop Python maths drifting from sim-core.

nodes.label: Decision 74 Generator design
nodes.rationale: Per-slot sha256-seeded streams keep tuning and retries local; byte-identical output per request.

nodes.label: Decision 75 Validator
nodes.rationale: The sim is the judge of playability; sweeps tune the generator rather than a second sensor model.

nodes.label: Decision 76 Generator tuning for the seed sweep
nodes.rationale: Masking the outer route and revealing the last stretch keeps terrain-masked attacks while guaranteeing warning time.

nodes.label: Decision 77 Defender policy and terminal-dive fix
nodes.rationale: Validator must measure playability, not a wasteful defender; a loitering munition that cannot hit was a sim bug.

nodes.label: Decision 78 JK_MOUNTAIN rebuilt with OSM buildings
nodes.rationale: Closes Phase 2A tech debt; buildings matter for NO_KINETIC siting.

nodes.label: Decision 79 Checkpoint adjustments
nodes.rationale: Shared targets in difficulty.ts; D1-D2 pacing; bird cap; live weather skipped.

nodes.label: Decision 80 POST /scenarios/generate
nodes.rationale: Role limits, deduplication and rate limit keep repeated Generate clicks from filling the table.

nodes.label: Decision 81 D1-D2 first threat varied
nodes.rationale: Against rote learning: class, spawn time and bearing randomised.

nodes.label: Decision 82 Step 10 HUD zones, hints, payload drop
nodes.rationale: Zones in neutral chrome tokens; hints use no truth; drop shown only when observed.

nodes.label: Decision 83 D4-D5 pop-down
nodes.rationale: Restores the low-altitude challenge lost by the clutter floor without breaking fairness.

nodes.label: Decision 84 Zone labels are plain DOM
nodes.rationale: drei Html roots caused React unmount race and removeChild errors.

nodes.label: Decision 85 Canvas pixel ratio capped and adaptive
nodes.rationale: JK D4 stutter was GPU headroom; fewest pixels for the same picture on scaled laptop screens.

nodes.label: Decision 86 EO/IR picture at 30 fps
nodes.rationale: Keep changes that reduce work by construction; do not tune on noise.

nodes.label: Decision 87 One time-of-day rule
nodes.rationale: One source for every Day/Dawn/Dusk/Night label and the generator's bands.

nodes.label: Decision 88 Building LOS index 25 m cells
nodes.rationale: URBAN_GENERIC will have thousands of footprints; the 2 ms tick budget must hold.
